g.text: bind inputs and create transient snapshot
of received values in four named header slots
normal HTTP, SSE, or business error response
Upstream verifies credential authenticity and action authorization.
Runtime does not check completeness, mutual exclusion, Bearer shape,
or whether Authorization and X-HW-APPKEY are both present.
Header names are case-insensitive under HTTP.
The contract preserves the exact access-token spelling.
Credential values remain opaque and are never logged,
persisted, copied into ResultBean, Prompt, or Event,
or used as Session ownership. The snapshot is discarded
when the execution ends. Runtime declares no local
